When installing the cable management system, we found that one
rope box for the right side was damaged. Please see the cracks
visible in the photo. No damage on the packaging was visible.
Therefore, we suspect the rope box was destroyed by abrupt
tension in the spring since the rope stopping mechanism was away
from the rope.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0441452-DC/Si-D/CZ-[MP/R1 170001440]Rope box right side is damaged CRM:02682000273
additional_info.body:
Dear Quality Team,
During the installation of the cable management system, RC reported that the rope box on the right side was found damaged. Please refer to the attached images showing visible cracks.
Notably, there was no visible damage to the packaging. Based on our observations, we suspect that the damage may have resulted from abrupt tension in the spring, possibly due to the rope stopping mechanism being positioned away from the rope.
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
: MP / R1 170001440
ChargerID/Serial No.
: t4Yq6t
Kindly review the attached photos and advise on the next steps.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -Ankita
